adjudication.rationale: In `admin/templates/group.hbs`, members are rendered as `{{each member in members itemView="group-member"}}`, so the `group-member` view/template runs in the *member* (a `Discourse.User`) context. In `admin/templates/group_member.hbs`, `{{#unless automatic}}...remove...{{/unless}}` therefore checks `automatic` on the user, where it is undefined/falsy, causing the remove link to render even for automatic groups. Clicking it triggers `actions.removeMember` in `admin/controllers/admin-group.js.es6`, which calls `model.removeMember(member)`; on automatic groups the server returns 422 (`Admin::GroupsController#remove_member` calls `can_not_modify_automatic`), and the returned rejected promise is not handled in the action, matching the finding’s described behavior.
